# adaptive-content

> One component, several variants. Only the variant that fits the width shows.

## Install
```bash
npm install @codergartenau/adaptive-content
```
```js
import '@codergartenau/adaptive-content';
```

## Use
```html
<adaptive-content>
  <p data-name="tiny" data-min="0">Plants turn light into food.</p>
  <p data-name="short" data-min="240">Plants use sunlight, water and CO2 to make sugar.</p>
  <template data-name="long" data-min="520"><p>Full explanation…</p></template>
</adaptive-content>
```

## API
- Variant attrs: `data-min` (default 0), `data-max` (default Infinity), `data-name` (event label).
- Host attr: `basis="container"` (default) | `"viewport"`.
- Selection: largest `data-min` with `width >= min && width <= max`, else smallest `min`.
- `template` variants clone once into `div[data-adaptive-rendered]` when first selected.
- JS: `el.update()`, `el.current`, event `adaptive-change` → `detail {variant, width, element}`.
- React: `import { AdaptiveContent } from '@codergartenau/adaptive-content/react'` with `basis`, `onChange(detail)`.
- SSR: hide un-initialized variants with `adaptive-content:not(:defined) > :not(:first-child) { display: none }`.
